card.name: Drug interaction effects on exposure
card.fires_on: Small words and digits inside drug-interaction sentences, just before the affected drug or a size of change in drug levels. Seen on 'of' after AUC or Cmax, a leading '1' in numbers like 16-fold or 10 days, and 'co' in co-administered.

modes.label: Of after exposure terms
modes.description: The word 'of' right after AUC, Cmax or concentrations, before the drug whose levels changed.
modes.example: Mavorixafor may increase the C max and AUC<< of>> CYP3A4 substrates [

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: The first digit '1' of a fold-change, percent or day count in interaction results.
modes.example: proate (500 mg BID) and olanzapine (5 mg) to healthy adults (n=10) caused <<1>>5% reduction in C max and

modes.label: Co-administration wording
modes.description: Part of 'co-administered' or a linking word after 'results in' in interaction statements.
modes.example: azole. Reduction in the dose of oxycodone and other long-acting opiates metabolized by CYP3A4 should be considered when<< co>>administered with voriconazole.
